pages.text: In 1867 Maxwell imagined a tiny being that opens a door only for fast molecules, sorting hot from cold for free - breaking the second law. The catch took a century to find: the demon must record each molecule, and erasing a bit of memory costs at least kT ln 2 of heat.

Information theory says the demon must pay to forget. Ours never forgets. Whether that is genius or a debt someone else will collect, I cannot say.$(br2)With enough $(item)Negentropy Cells$() and $(fluid)Dark Energy$() you can even reverse the heat death of a universe.
Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.$(br2)Made in $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Negentropy Cell$(): Anomaly Resolution Engine, Arrow of Time Shard, Boltzmann Fluctuation, Entropy Horizon, Inflaton Field and more
